blocks.source: ｸﾘｱ日
blocks.translation: Clear Date
Around May 2005

blocks.source: 本作品はＳＦＣで発売された初代ロマンシングサガをＰＳ２にてリメイクしたもの。ストーリーやキャラクターはほぼ同じであるが、グラフィック・システム・音楽・ボイスの追加など、至るところで大きく変更されており、別物と言って良いレベルで変更されている。
blocks.translation: This game is a PS2 remake of the original Romancing SaGa, which was released for the SFC. The story and characters are mostly the same, but almost everything has been significantly changed, including the graphics, systems, music, and added voice acting. The changes are extensive enough that it can fairly be called a different game.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Substance / Story

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ時代からの特徴だったフリーシナリオは健在。一度のプレイではやりきれない程、イベントが豊富なのも同じ。追加のイベントもあり、ＳＦＣで消化不良だった設定の数々が補完された。特に手に入れられないデスティニーストーンや、シェラハの存在などの謎は大きく解消された。イベントの中には複数周回を前提としたものもあるが、それに耐えうるだけの内容の濃さを持っている。
blocks.translation: The free-scenario system that was a defining feature since the SFC era remains intact. As before, there are so many events that they cannot all be completed in a single playthrough. There are also additional events, filling in many of the settings that were left underdeveloped in the SFC version. Mysteries such as the unobtainable Destiny Stones and the existence of Schirach have been greatly clarified. Some events assume multiple playthroughs, but they have enough depth to withstand that.

blocks.source: 主人公によっては敵と戦う動機が弱いのは相変わらず。ＳＦＣ版をプレイしたことが無いプレイヤーならば、何をして良いのかわからない状況に陥ることもあり得る。
blocks.translation: As before, some protagonists have little motivation to fight the enemies. Players who have never played the SFC version may even find themselves unsure of what they are supposed to do.

blocks.source: 例えば、ロマサガ２ならば七英雄を倒すという明確な目標が序盤から最後まであった。しかし、こちらは序盤のイベントとラスボス戦を除けばプレイヤーが必ずこなさなければならないイベントはほとんど存在しない。一応、四天王なるものも存在するが、倒す必要はない。交渉しても良いし、無視することも許される。
blocks.translation: For example, Romancing SaGa 2 had the clear goal of defeating the Seven Heroes from the beginning through to the end. In this game, however, apart from the early events and the final boss battle, there are very few events that the player is required to complete. There are beings known as the Four Lords, but defeating them is not necessary. You can negotiate with them or simply ignore them.

blocks.source: 元々、個性的なイベントやセリフ回しが多いことで有名な作品。『アイスソード』にまつわるイベントはもはや伝説となっている感がある。今回もこれらの個性的なイベントは表現こそ、多少変わっているが健在だ。
blocks.translation: This game was already well known for its many distinctive events and memorable lines. The event involving the “Ice Sword” has practically become legendary. These distinctive events are still present this time, although their presentation has changed somewhat.

blocks.source: システム
blocks.translation: Systems

blocks.source: 『シンボルエンカウント』『閃き』『連携』といったシリーズの人気を支えてきた要素は健在。ちなみに閃きはロマサガ２、連携はサガフロ１が初出。ロマサガ１の頃には存在しなかったが逆輸入されている。
blocks.translation: The elements that have supported the series’ popularity, such as “symbol encounters,” “glimmers,” and “combos,” remain intact. Incidentally, glimmers first appeared in Romancing SaGa 2, while combos debuted in SaGa Frontier 1. They did not exist in the days of Romancing SaGa 1, but were imported back into it.

blocks.source: その他の要素には色々と大きな変更がある。まず、特徴として挙げられるのはＢＰ制による戦闘システム。技の使用にはターン毎に溜まるＢＰを消費する。ＢＰは次の戦闘に持ち越すことはできないので、ＭＰ等とは概念が異なる。「消耗を気にするより、１回１回の戦闘を全力で戦え」というこのシリーズらしいシステムだ。
blocks.translation: There have also been many major changes to the other elements. The first notable one is the battle system based on BP. Using techniques consumes BP, which accumulates each turn. BP cannot be carried over to the next battle, so it differs conceptually from MP and similar resources. It is a system characteristic of this series: “Rather than worrying about attrition, fight every battle at full strength.”

blocks.source: また、武器にはＥＰ（耐久度）が設定されており、技を使用すると消耗する。後述するクラスの活用や武器の耐久強化によって、消耗を抑えることも可能である。耐久度は基本的に宿屋に泊まると回復するので、どちらかというと、こちらの方がＭＰの概念に近い。
blocks.translation: Weapons also have EP (durability), which is consumed when techniques are used. It is possible to reduce this consumption by making use of the classes described below and improving weapon durability. Durability is basically restored by staying at an inn, so in that respect it is closer to the concept of MP.

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ版ではゲーム開始時に主人公の両親の職業を設定することで、能力が変化するという要素があった。ミンストレルソングでは廃止になった代わりにクラス（職業）という要素が追加されており、開始時に決めることができる。
blocks.translation: In the SFC version, setting the occupations of the protagonist’s parents at the start of the game affected their abilities. Minstrel Song removes this feature, but adds the concept of classes (occupations), which can be chosen at the beginning.

blocks.source: クラスはそれぞれ『特性』や『スキル』を持っており、例えば『海賊』ならば「素早く行動できる」といった特性がある。また、保有するスキルと同じ種類の武器や魔法を使用すれば消費するＥＰやＬＰを抑えることができる。
blocks.translation: Each class has its own “traits” and “skills.” For example, the “Pirate” class has the trait “can act quickly.” Using weapons or magic of the same types as the skills a class possesses also reduces EP and LP consumption.

blocks.source: なお、クラスはイベントを攻略した際に手に入る『ジュエル』を消費することで、変更したりレベルを上げたりすることが可能だ。
blocks.translation: Classes can be changed or leveled up by spending “Jewels,” which are obtained by completing events.

blocks.source: もったいないと思ったのは『術合成』のクラス特性。２～３の術を合成することで、既存の術を強化したり、新たな術を覚えたりできるのだが、『３術合成』が使えるクラスは『ローザリア術法士』だけ。
blocks.translation: The class trait “Spell Synthesis” feels like a missed opportunity. By combining two or three spells, you can enhance existing spells or learn new ones, but the only class that can use “Three-Spell Synthesis” is the “Rosalian Sorcerer.”

blocks.source: このクラスは『水術』『魔術』『気術』をスキルとして保有しているのだが『火術』などそれ以外の合成術を使おうとすると、ＬＰの消費が大きく不利になってしまう。せっかく、合成術という要素が存在するのに実用段階で術の種類が限られてしまうのは悲しい。
blocks.translation: This class possesses “Water Magic,” “Sorcery,” and “Aura Magic” as skills, but using synthesized spells outside those categories, such as “Fire Magic,” results in a major LP cost disadvantage. It is disappointing that, despite the existence of spell synthesis, the types of spells that are practical to use are limited.

blocks.source: 『マップアビリティ』の追加によって、戦闘面以外での駆引きが行われるようになった。この辺はアンサガにあった要素を万人向けに洗練した印象。『ステルス』や『忍び足』によって、敵シンボルを避ける事ができるのは快適。ただし、宝箱を開けるのに『カギ開け』や『ワナ解除』が必要といった面倒があるのもアンサガに近い。
blocks.translation: The addition of “Map Abilities” introduced tactical considerations outside of battle. This feels like a refinement of elements from Unlimited SaGa for a wider audience. Being able to avoid enemy symbols with “Stealth” and “Hawk Walk” is convenient. However, the need for abilities such as “Lockpicking” and “Trap Disarmament” to open treasure chests is an inconvenience reminiscent of Unlimited SaGa.

blocks.source: 全体的にかなり複雑な部類だが、荒削り止まりで終わっていたアンサガ辺りと比較すると、各要素がうまく機能している印象。各町にいる『ギユウ軍』によるヘルプもそれなりに充実している。
blocks.translation: Overall, it is quite complex, but compared with Unlimited SaGa, whose elements remained somewhat rough around the edges, this game gives the impression that each element works well. The help provided by the “Gyuyun Army” members in each town is also fairly comprehensive.

blocks.source: バランス
blocks.translation: Balance

blocks.source: ザコ戦・ボス戦共に手応え抜群。凝った戦闘・成長システムに加えて豊富な技・術が存在するためキャラクターを強くする楽しさがある。
blocks.translation: Both regular and boss battles offer an excellent challenge. In addition to its intricate battle and growth systems, the game has a wealth of techniques and spells, making it fun to strengthen your characters.

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ版は意外にも、ボス戦の少ないゲームで、むしろザコ戦に苦しまされることが多かった。今回は出番の増えたミニオン、デスティニーストーンを守る守護者など、多くのイベントで手強いボスと戦うことになる。それでいて、ＳＦＣ版の様にザコ敵に１ターンで全滅させられるような理不尽もほぼ無くなった。
blocks.translation: Despite appearances, the SFC version had relatively few boss battles, and players were more often troubled by regular battles. This time, you will fight formidable bosses in many events, including the more prominent Minions and guardians protecting the Destiny Stones. At the same time, the unreasonable situations from the SFC version, such as being wiped out by regular enemies in a single turn, have almost disappeared.

blocks.source: サガにしてはラスボスが弱めなのは少し残念。ラストダンジョン前に難易度が高いイベントがあるので、それをクリアしたプレイヤーのパーティならば、さほど苦戦せずに倒せてしまうはず。（しかし、条件を満たすと超強くなったりするが。）
blocks.translation: It is a little disappointing that the final boss is rather weak for a SaGa game. There is a difficult event before the final dungeon, so a party that has cleared it should be able to defeat the final boss without too much trouble. (However, it can become extremely powerful if certain conditions are met.)

blocks.source: 今までのサガシリーズではイベント中にボスに勝てなくなって、ハマリ状態に陥ることもあったが、宿屋でのみできる『通常セーブ』とどこでもできる『クイックセーブ』を分けたため、その心配も減った。これにより、ボスに勝てなくなっても通常セーブを行った時点までは戻ることができる。
blocks.translation: In previous SaGa games, it was possible to become unable to defeat a boss during an event and end up stuck. That concern is reduced here because “regular saves,” which can only be made at inns, and “quick saves,” which can be made anywhere, are separate. Even if you can no longer defeat a boss, you can return to the point at which you made your regular save.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: マップが少し広めで移動に時間が掛かる。マップの切替にかかるロード時間は長めだが、戦闘のロード時間は短め。
blocks.translation: The maps are somewhat large, making travel time-consuming. Loading times when switching maps are on the long side, but battle loading times are relatively short.

blocks.source: 戦闘テンポは非常に良い。ＳＦＣのロマサガ２，３では、技名の表示にウェイトが掛かっていたが、当作品では技名の表示と同時に攻撃演出が行われるのでスムーズ。技自体の演出も格好良く、かつテンポ良い。戦闘テンポに関して言えばロマサガ２，３を総合的に上回っているかと思う。
blocks.translation: The battle tempo is excellent. In SFC’s Romancing SaGa 2 and 3, displaying a technique’s name involved a pause, but in this game the attack animation begins as soon as the technique name appears, making things smooth. The technique animations themselves are stylish and well-paced. In terms of battle tempo, I think it surpasses Romancing SaGa 2 and 3 overall.

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ版ではゲンナリする程、ザコ敵シンボルがウジャウジャ出たが、今回はさすがに自重されている。それに慣れさえすれば敵は簡単に避けることも可能だ。
blocks.translation: In the SFC version, regular enemy symbols appeared in swarms to the point of becoming exhausting, but they have been kept under control this time. Once you get used to it, it is also possible to avoid enemies easily.

blocks.source: こういうゲームシステムが複雑な作品はプレイしていて面倒臭いことが多い。この作品については比較的、そういった面倒臭さは抑えられていることは評価できる。
blocks.translation: Games with complex systems like this are often tedious to play. This game deserves credit for keeping that kind of tediousness relatively well under control.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: キャラクターデザインはＳＦＣ版から大きく変化。なぜか角の生えた『シフ』、頭が禿げた『ガラハド』など、元の面影がほとんど見られないキャラも。ＰＳ２のＲＰＧにしては頭身が低め。個人的にはすぐ慣れたのだが、受け入れられない人もいる模様。
blocks.translation: The character designs have changed significantly from the SFC version. Some characters, such as “Sif,” who inexplicably has horns, and “Galahad,” who is bald, bear almost no resemblance to their original appearances. The characters have relatively short proportions for a PS2 RPG. I personally got used to it quickly, although some people apparently cannot accept it.

blocks.source: 激しい戦闘を処理するためか、戦闘背景はアンサガと比較して非常に簡素。とはいえ、戦闘エフェクトは派手かつテンポ良い。敵味方共に様々な技が飛び交うのは見ていて楽しい。
blocks.translation: Perhaps to accommodate the intense battles, the battle backgrounds are extremely simple compared with Unlimited SaGa. Even so, the battle effects are flashy and well-paced. It is fun to watch the various techniques flying back and forth from both enemies and allies.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 作曲者はＳＦＣ版と同じく伊藤賢治氏。関戸剛氏も作曲・編曲に参加している。
blocks.translation: The composer is Kenji Ito, as in the SFC version. Tsuyoshi Sekito also contributed to the composition and arrangement.

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ版と比較して、大きく変化している曲が多い。通常戦闘曲やラスボス曲はイントロしか共通点が無いがこれはこれでカッコいい曲。
blocks.translation: Many tracks have changed significantly compared with the SFC version. The regular battle and final boss themes share only their intros with the originals, but they are still cool tracks in their own right.

blocks.source: 戦闘曲は元々ザコ・ボス・ラスボスの３種類しかなかったが、今回大幅に追加されている。特にミニオン戦で流れる『熱情の律動』はなぜかフラメンコ調だったりとハイセンス。
blocks.translation: Originally, there were only three battle themes—for regular enemies, bosses, and the final boss—but many more have been added this time. “The Rhythmic Pulse of Passion,” which plays during Minion battles in particular, is impressively stylish, with its unexpectedly flamenco-inspired sound.

blocks.source: イトケンらしくダンジョン曲のクオリティが高いのも特徴。ＳＦＣの面影を残したアレンジの『最終試練』など良曲揃い。
blocks.translation: Another characteristic is the high quality of the dungeon music, as one would expect from Ito. It is full of excellent tracks, including “The Final Trial,” an arrangement that retains echoes of the SFC original.

blocks.source: 各キャラクターのテーマ曲も多彩だが、中でもグレイのテーマが最もお気に入り。
blocks.translation: The character theme songs are also varied, but Gray’s theme is my favorite.

The technique animations themselves are stylish and well-paced. In terms of battle tempo, I think it surpasses Romancing SaGa 2 and 3 overall.

texts.こういうゲームシステムが複雑な作品はプレイしていて面倒臭いことが多い。この作品に: Games with complex systems like this are often tedious to play. This game deserves credit for keeping that kind of tediousness relatively well under control.
texts.キャラクターデザインはＳＦＣ版から大きく変化。なぜか角の生えた『シフ』、頭が禿げ: The character designs have changed significantly from the SFC version. Some characters, such as “Sif,” who inexplicably has horns, and “Galahad,” who is bald, bear almost no resemblance to their original appearances. The characters have relatively short proportions for a PS2 RPG. I personally got used to it quickly, although some people apparently cannot accept it.
texts.激しい戦闘を処理するためか、戦闘背景はアンサガと比較して非常に簡素。とはいえ、戦: Perhaps to accommodate the intense battles, the battle backgrounds are extremely simple compared with Unlimited SaGa. Even so, the battle effects are flashy and well-paced. It is fun to watch the various techniques flying back and forth from both enemies and allies.
texts.作曲者はＳＦＣ版と同じく伊藤賢治氏。関戸剛氏も作曲・編曲に参加している。: The composer is Kenji Ito, as in the SFC version. Tsuyoshi Sekito also contributed to the composition and arrangement.
texts.ＳＦＣ版と比較して、大きく変化している曲が多い。通常戦闘曲やラスボス曲はイントロ: Many tracks have changed significantly compared with the SFC version. The regular battle and final boss themes share only their intros with the originals, but they are still cool tracks in their own right.
texts.戦闘曲は元々ザコ・ボス・ラスボスの３種類しかなかったが、今回大幅に追加されている: Originally, there were only three battle themes—for regular enemies, bosses, and the final boss—but many more have been added this time. “The Rhythmic Pulse of Passion,” which plays during Minion battles in particular, is impressively stylish, with its unexpectedly flamenco-inspired sound.
texts.イトケンらしくダンジョン曲のクオリティが高いのも特徴。ＳＦＣの面影を残したアレン: Another characteristic is the high quality of the dungeon music, as one would expect from Ito. It is full of excellent tracks, including “The Final Trial,” an arrangement that retains echoes of the SFC original.
texts.各キャラクターのテーマ曲も多彩だが、中でもグレイのテーマが最もお気に入り。: The character theme songs are also varied, but Gray’s theme is my favorite.
